description: This file contains a unit test class for the FormatWithPayGradeId class, testing its ability to format pay grade IDs into human-readable salary grades within the OrangeHRM system. It sets up necessary test fixtures, initializes the class under test, and verifies expected output for specific inputs.

classes.name: FormatWithPayGradeIdTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test case for the FormatWithPayGradeId class, verifying formatting of pay grade IDs.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment, loads configuration fixtures, and creates the object under test with mocked services.

methods.name: testGetFormattedValue
methods.description: Verifies that the getFormattedValue method correctly formats pay grade IDs into salary grade names or returns null for unknown IDs.
